# ECDLPResource17.OrderScope

**OrderScope**

保留全曲线Hasse、实际cofactor和近n位cyclic order的不同前提，并证明真正均值。

**边界**：PDF pp17–18. Hasse controls#E(Fp), not arbitrary subgroup r. Even full curve order can lie slightly below2^(n−1) for an n-bit p near its lower endpoint. Source approximation needs a separately certified order range.
